text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming the modern workplace. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, such as data entry or scheduling, which frees up employees for more creative work. At the same time, productivity tools powered by AI help workers analyze large amounts of information quickly and even draft emails or reports. However, this shift does not mean humans become unnecessary. Instead, human-AI collaboration is key: people provide judgment and empathy, while AI offers speed and accuracy. Of course, some jobs will change or disappear, so workers must learn new skills to stay competitive. Overall, AI is not replacing us—it’s changing how we work, making many roles more efficient and interesting.
